en.headline: Labour Department bars firm from imported-worker applications for two years
en.dek: The department said the firm added hiring conditions without consent and refused qualified local applicants for clerk and painting-worker posts.
body: The Labour Department has imposed an administrative sanction on 浩展太平洋集團有限公司, immediately suspending the company's submitted applications under the Enhanced Supplementary Labour Scheme and refusing to process any further applications from the firm under the scheme for two years.

A department spokesman said an investigation found the company had breached scheme rules during the required local open recruitment for general clerks and painting workers. The breaches included adding recruitment conditions without the department's consent and refusing, without reasonable grounds, to hire qualified jobseekers.

Under the scheme, employers who cannot fill technician-level or below posts locally may apply to import workers, but only after a local recruitment exercise that gives priority to suitable local workers. The department can suspend applications, withdraw approvals already granted, or refuse later applications if an employer breaches labour or immigration law, the scheme rules, or the standard employment contract.
RTHK reported the announcement on Tuesday afternoon. The department did not, in that account, say how many posts were involved or whether any imported workers were already in post.

zh.headline: 勞工處制裁浩展太平洋 兩年內不受理輸入勞工申請
zh.dek: 處方說該公司申請輸入普通文員及髹漆工時，未經同意新增招聘條件，並無合理理由拒絕合資格求職者。
body: 勞工處星期二宣布，對浩展太平洋集團有限公司實施行政制裁，即時中止該公司已提交的「補充勞工優化計劃」輸入勞工申請，並由即日起拒絕處理該公司隨後兩年在計劃下提交的申請。
發言人說，調查確定該公司在申請輸入普通文員及髹漆工的本地公開招聘期間違反計劃規定，包括在未獲勞工處同意下新增招聘條件，以及無合理理由拒絕聘用合資格求職者。
優化計劃容許確實未能在本港聘得技術員級別或以下人手的僱主申請輸入勞工，但必須先進行處方規定的本地公開招聘，優先聘用合適本地工人。僱主如違反勞工或入境法例、計劃規定或標準僱傭合約，處方可中止已提交申請、撤銷已批出的輸入批准，或拒絕處理其後申請。
港台下午報道這項宣布。報道沒有交代涉及多少個職位，亦沒有說明是否已有輸入勞工在職。
